# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Cost-reduction opportunity (if `cost`/`latency`/`num_messages` is a declared objective,
      run `detect_loop_patterns.py --run-dir $R --tag $BEST --split val` — free, no extra
      eval — and check its `by_tool` map for a same-tool-called-N-times-in-a-row pattern. A
      hit names the exact tool + repeat count: propose a composite/bulk tool (capability
      `tools`), a bundled script entrypoint (`skills-package`), or upfront-batched
      instructions (`prompt`/`system-prompt`) that replace the N calls with one. No hit
      (or cost/latency not a declared objective): say so plainly, do not leave this blank):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — create airline capability from empty seed: 2 new read tools + 3 code guards/returns + policy contract
- Changes I made (1 line per edit):
  - tools.py `find_reservations` (NEW read tool) — cluster A (wrong-reservation targeting, tasks 17/22): list a user's reservations with route/date/flight filters so the agent matches the described trip instead of grabbing the first id.
  - policy.md "Identify the correct reservation first" (+worked example) — cluster A: imperative to resolve+confirm the id via find_reservations, never assume the first.
  - tools.py `get_price_quote` (NEW read tool) — cluster B (guessed/stale booking total, tasks 25/23): authoritative total from CURRENT prices before booking.
  - tools.py `book_reservation` enriched errors (code) — cluster B/E: "does not add up" now names total+breakdown+signed shortfall+resubmit instruction; payment-not-found lists available ids.
  - tools.py `cancel_reservation` flown/already-cancelled guard (code) — cluster D (task 37-t2): refuse cancel when any segment already flown (date<today or status flying/landed).
  - tools.py `update_reservation_flights` + `update_reservation_baggages` return payment_delta/amount_charged/amount_refunded (code) — cluster C (task 11 COMMUNICATE "5244"): surface the engine's exact amount.
  - policy.md: "Execute immediately after confirmation" + "Recover from a write error" + authoritative-pricing + quote-the-returned-amount rules — clusters E/B/C.
- Per change, EXPECTED effect + why safe:
  - find_reservations/get_price_quote are ADDITIVE read tools (16 tools total, <20) — cannot change any existing passing call.
  - book_reservation error edit only changes text on an already-erroring call; passing bookings never hit the branch.
  - cancel guard VERIFIED to not fire on the legit cancels in passing trials 19-t1 (Z7GOZK future 05-28) and 23-t1 (K1NW8N future 05-26/28); fires on 37-t2 NQNU5R (05-13/14 flown).
  - update-tool return is a dict superset of the full reservation dump + delta fields; DB mutation is in place BEFORE the return, so DB grading unchanged; adds the value the COMMUNICATE check reads.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none — iteration 1, empty LEDGER/JOURNAL/RUNMAP, empty rejected.jsonl/history.jsonl.
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters still not cracked: cluster E (narrate-without-action/bail-out) is addressed only by prose this iteration — the stall is the agent ending its turn, which no code guard can force. If it survives, next lever is a composite confirm->write tool (then remove the write primitives). Cluster A relies on the agent CHOOSING to call find_reservations; if 17/22 still fail, consider an in-body guard in the update/cancel tools that rejects a write whose supplied flights' route doesn't match the reservation's origin/destination.
- Plateau signal: n/a (first iteration).
- Cost-reduction: cost/latency/num_messages not declared objectives here (reward basis is DB+COMMUNICATE); did not run detect_loop_patterns.
- Focus next iteration: read the RESULT; if cluster A/E unmoved, switch from read-tool+prose to in-body write guards / composite write tool.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.417 Δ=+0.100 · fixed={—} · broke={—} · unresolved={11, 12, 19, 25, 37, 8} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them). — no task that was passing under the parent regressed: this batch did not clear the gate's threshold, it did not do damage. So the lever is POWER or SIZE, not a redesign — re-measure with more trials in ONE evaluation, or make the effect bigger. Keep the edits that produced the `fixed` tasks above as your starting point; do not rewrite them on this round's numbers.
